# Project status

Living document. Original handoff status (2026-10-15) is preserved in `docs/handoff/PROJECT_STATUS.md`.
Real-data results below are **retrospective backtests** (replayed under a known-at policy), not live
forecasts. Synthetic results come from a fictional league and only test the machinery.

## Market-residual family (owner decision 2026-10-19)
Market lines may be inputs to this separate family only; the independent forecast never sees them, and the two are
reported separately and never blended. Research and paper tracking only.
- Line audit (`docs/data_sources/market_lines.md`): one line per game in nflverse, updated in place, timing
  undocumented, so treated as the close; live runs time-stamp lines from 2026.
- Pre-registration (`docs/market_biases.md`, `6b487e1`, + Amendment 1 `ab26c3b`): 10 retrospective hypotheses
  (Holm), 2 live-only, (h) on 2020–2025 only; validation 2006–2017, holdout 2018–2025 **sealed**.
- Validation (`docs/market_validation_results.md`): **no hypothesis survives Holm**; closest b (underdogs vs 7+ road
  favorites, 56.2%, raw p 0.09) and c2 (dome overs +5.0 pts, raw p 0.051). `market_logit` is slightly worse than the
  market alone out of sample (win +0.0013, cover +0.0008, over +0.0011 Brier; MDE ≈ 0.002). Moneyline calibration
  slope 1.015.
- Live (tracking only): frozen `market_logit` (fit 2006–2017) archived to `ledger/market_residual/forecasts.jsonl`;
  spread/total paper picks in `ledger/paper_picks/picks_market_<date>.csv`; both scored in their own section of
  `reports/prospective_scores.md`.

## Holdout revealed (2026-10-19)

Designs frozen in `docs/holdout_freeze.md` (commit `65e08df`) and the 2020–2025 holdout revealed once;
full write-up in `docs/holdout_results.md`. Out-of-sample results:
- Win probability `elo_tuned`: Brier 0.2230 (validation 0.2194); beats home-rate by −0.0265
  [−0.0323, −0.0207]; market better by +0.0130 [+0.0093, +0.0167]. Main miscalibration: home-field
  advantage shrank after 2019 (home teams forecast ≈ 0.567, won 0.50–0.58, 0.536 in 2024–25).
- Margin/total `scores_points_empirical`: CRPS 7.33 / 7.58, beats naive, intervals and PIT calibrated;
  market lines ≈ 0.4 points MAE better.
- Player yards `players_opp_eff`: beats recent average for rushing (−0.35) and receiving (−0.35), not
  passing; receiving and passing coverage calibrated, rushing intervals slightly too wide.
- The holdout is now used: further design changes must be judged on prospective (2026+) forecasts.
- Reports now say "already revealed" instead of "sealed"; reveal runs keep dated `*_holdout_*.md`
  copies. The scores and players holdout reports are preserved as `*_holdout_20261019T1735Z.md`; the
  win-probability holdout report was overwritten by a later run, but its numbers are in
  `docs/holdout_results.md` and all forecasts remain in `archive/`.

## Paper picks (2026-10-19; research tracking, not wagering advice)
- Each live run appends `ledger/paper_picks/picks_<date>.csv` (requested columns plus Paper Only, Issued At,
  Run ID, Model, Edge, Market Implied P, Game ID, Pick Side). Pick = side where `elo_tuned` most exceeds the
  raw moneyline implied probability at issue (incl. margin); paper stake 1 unit if edge ≥ 0.03;
  confidence High ≥ 0.10, Medium ≥ 0.05. Rows are written even without odds (no edge, no stake).
- `sfi score` grades the latest pre-kickoff pick per game: paper profit at the odds at issue, return per
  unit with week-block CI, closing-line value, hit rate vs mean pick probability.
- Expectation stated up front: `elo_tuned` trails the market out of sample (Brier +0.013), so most
  "edges" should be model error. A dry run flagged 8 of 15 games for a paper stake.

## Line-movement dataset (2026-10-19)
- `sfi score` appends one row per final game to `ledger/market_moves.jsonl`: de-vigged market P(home) at
  issue (from the run that issued the latest pre-kickoff `elo_tuned` forecast) and at close (scoring
  snapshot), `market_move` = close − at issue. `reports/prospective_scores.md` shows Brier of
  `elo_tuned`, market at issue and market close on games with |move| ≥ 0.05, with counts and how often the
  market moved toward Elo's side. No model change.

## `elo_avail`: weighted starter availability (2026-10-19; validation sanity only)
- Expected starters from depth charts (same-week weekly chart through 2024, publish time undocumented;
  latest daily snapshot ≤ as-of from 2025) listed Out/Doubtful on an injury report known by as-of,
  grouped QB / OL / secondary / pass rush / skill with fixed weights 3.0 / 1.0 / 1.0 / 0.7 / 0.5.
  Ridge logistic on Elo logit + home−away weighted score (unscaled), L2 10, refit each season.
- Validation 2010–2019 (2,662 games): elo_avail − elo_tuned **−0.0007 [−0.0019, +0.0005]**, no clear
  difference; subset with either team 2+ starters out (1,007 games): −0.0006 [−0.0035, +0.0022].
  Effect per weighted starter out: −0.11 logit (2019 fit). Starters found for 99.96% of team-games.
- Not promoted; to be judged prospectively under a pre-registered rule (item 5).

## `elo_qbadj`: QB-adjusted Elo (2026-10-19; validation sanity only)
- Team Elo adjusted by 875 × (expected starter's prior qb_epa/dropback rating − team's season QB
  baseline); expected starter = first depth-chart QB not Out/Doubtful before as-of (previous starter if
  no chart); adjustment also used in the rating update. All settings fixed by reasoning.
- Validation 2010–2019: elo_qbadj − elo_tuned **−0.0004 [−0.0022, +0.0014]**, no clear difference;
  subset where a team's actual starter changed (506 games): −0.0008 [−0.0082, +0.0068]. Over 2001–2019
  it leans worse (+0.0012 [−0.0003, +0.0026]); 2001–2009 lacks injury reports.
- Not promoted; to be judged prospectively under a pre-registered rule (item 5).

## Live challengers (2026-10-19)
- `elo_avail` and `elo_qbadj` pre-registered in `docs/challenger_avail_qbadj.md` (commit `cef522f`,

## Pregame weather recording (2026-10-19; data collection only)
- Open-Meteo evaluated (`docs/data_sources/open_meteo.md`): free non-commercial, CC BY 4.0. Its historical
  forecast archive is not point-in-time; the point-in-time Previous Runs archive starts Jan 2024. So each
  live run now records the forecast at issue time (kickoff hour and 3-hour window: temperature, wind,
  gusts, precipitation and its probability) for non-dome games in `weather_at_issue` of the run log.
  No model uses weather until at least a season has been recorded.

## `elo_combo` (2026-10-19)
- Stacks the learned home edge (`elo_hfa`), QB adjustment (`elo_qbadj`) and availability layer
  (`elo_avail`, QB group weighted 0 to avoid double counting) at their fixed settings.
- Validation 2010–2019 (sanity only): vs `elo_tuned` +0.0001 [−0.0018, +0.0020]; vs `elo_avail`
  +0.0008 [−0.0010, +0.0027]: the small component effects do not add up visibly.
- Pre-registered (`docs/challenger_combo.md`, commit `781f15c`, 14:12 ET) with a 98.75% (Bonferroni, 4)
  rule; runs live as the fourth challenger.
- Power analysis (`docs/power_analysis.md`): 0.002 is only borderline detectable on 2010–2019 for
  `elo_avail` (MDE 0.0018) and not for `elo_qbadj` (0.0026); 500 prospective games detect only ≈ 0.004–0.006.
- Market-disagreement study (`docs/market_disagreement.md`, hypothesis generator only): market Brier
  better in every disagreement bucket; paper returns indistinguishable from zero.

## `elo_sched`: schedule context (2026-10-19; validation only, not live)
- From the schedule alone: rest difference (±7 cap), bye and short-week differences, travel difference
  (home-venue-per-season to venue, miles), time zones crossed (|Δlongitude|/15), primetime, divisional.
  Ridge on the tuned-Elo logit, L2 10, refit each season. Stadium table extended to every venue since 2000.
- Validation 2010–2019 (sanity only): +0.0002 [−0.0010, +0.0014]; |rest diff| ≥ 3 (602 games):
  −0.0016 [−0.0044, +0.0012]; travel > 1,500 mi (558 games): +0.0012 [−0.0032, +0.0057]. No clear effect.

## Earlier state (2026-10-15 to 2026-10-18)

### Built and verified
- Python package `sfi` (Python 3.14 venv; deps: numpy, pyyaml, tzdata, pytest). `pytest`: **51 passed**.
- **Real data:** nflverse schedules adapter (owner confirmed non-commercial research use with CC-BY
  attribution on 2026-10-15). Immutable checksummed snapshots with manifests; `sfi fetch` for new pulls.
  Snapshot in use: retrieved 2026-10-15T19:19:32Z, SHA-256 `cf5b5f6b…`, 7,289 games 2000–2026.
- Normalization: Eastern kickoff → UTC (`tzdata`), franchise continuity (OAK→LV, SD→LAC, STL→LA),
  neutral sites (102), playoffs included, `result_known_at = kickoff + 5h`, consistency checks, and a
  per-team timeline check (each result known before that team's next kickoff).
- **Upstream defect found and repaired:** 101 night games from 2000–2005 are stored as `09:00` instead of
  `21:00` Eastern, which would have made results look known about 12 hours before kickoff. Fixed by a
  narrow, logged rule (102 rows including one neutral-site game). Not yet reported to nflverse.
- Market moneylines (de-vigged) scored as a **benchmark only**; market and weather columns never reach models.
- Walk-forward now forecasts each **kickoff slate** 1h before kickoff (a Sunday-night forecast can use
  Sunday-afternoon results once known).
- Elo: no home-field advantage at neutral sites; ratings keyed by franchise.
- **Sealed holdout:** `backtest` doesn't load holdout seasons unless `--reveal-holdout` is passed; each
  reveal is logged to `archive/holdout_reveals.jsonl`.
- Synthetic league (2017–2024) retained for pipeline tests; tuning, Platt recalibration and the archive
  work as before.

### Real NFL results — validation 2001–2019 (holdout 2020–2025 sealed)
Splits fixed by the owner on 2026-10-15 before any real-data results were viewed. 5,055 scored games
(10 ties excluded); Elo was tuned on these same seasons, so its scores here are slightly optimistic.

| Model | Games | Brier | 95% CI | Log loss | Calib. slope |
|---|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|
| market_moneyline (benchmark) | 3,593 | 0.2117 | [0.2059, 0.2175] | 0.6106 | 1.01 |
| elo_tuned | 5,055 | 0.2194 | [0.2155, 0.2232] | 0.6283 | 1.07 |
| elo_tuned_platt | 5,055 | 0.2196 | [0.2154, 0.2236] | 0.6286 | 1.02 |
| elo_default | 5,055 | 0.2198 | [0.2156, 0.2240] | 0.6290 | 0.94 |
| home_rate | 5,055 | 0.2449 | [0.2429, 0.2467] | 0.6829 | n/a |
| coin_flip | 5,055 | 0.2500 | – | 0.6931 | n/a |

- Tuned Elo: K 20, home field 48, season regression **0.5** (default 0.33); not at a grid edge.
- **Elo clearly beats the home-rate baseline:** −0.0255 Brier, CI [−0.0290, −0.0218].
- **Tuning barely matters** on real data: −0.0004 vs the default, CI [−0.0011, +0.0002].
- **Elo is already well calibrated** (slope ≈ 1); Platt recalibration adds nothing measurable.
- **The market is clearly better:** Elo − market = +0.0070 Brier, CI [+0.0038, +0.0101], on the 3,593
  games with moneylines (mostly 2006+). The market reflects injuries, QB changes and news that a
  results-only Elo can't see. Caveat: the line's timestamp is undocumented and probably near kickoff.

### Play-by-play team features (2026-10-18; experimental, not used live)
- Downloaded nflverse play-by-play 2000–2026 (27 parquet files, 459 MB, CC-BY 4.0; owner-approved),
  checksummed per season; `sfi fetch --pbp` re-downloads only seasons that changed upstream.
- Per team and game, offense and defense: EPA/play, success rate, pass EPA, rush EPA, explosive-play
  rate (pass ≥ 20 yd, rush ≥ 10 yd), early-down pass rate, turnover rate, pressure rate (proxy: sack or
  QB hit per dropback). Each as a 4-game rolling value (crossing seasons) and season-to-date (falling
  back to last season early on), play-weighted, built only from games already released by the replay.
- Models: ridge logistic regression on the Elo logit plus home-minus-away differences, refit at each
  season start on past forecasts only (L2 = 10, fixed). `pbp_logit_epa` uses EPA/play only (4 diffs);
  `pbp_logit_full` uses all 32. Holdout play-by-play (2020–2025) is not loaded by the backtest.
- Caveat: nflverse EPA comes from a model trained on many seasons, so historical EPA has a small look-ahead.

Validation 2001–2019 (5,055 games), paired Brier differences:

| Comparison | Diff | 95% CI | Reading |
|---|---:|---|---|
| pbp_logit_epa − elo_tuned | −0.0004 | [−0.0015, +0.0007] | no clear difference |
| pbp_logit_full − elo_tuned | +0.0017 | [−0.0006, +0.0039] | no clear difference |
| pbp_logit_full − pbp_logit_epa | +0.0020 | [+0.0002, +0.0039] | EPA-only better |
| pbp_logit_epa − market | +0.0063 | [+0.0034, +0.0094] | market better |

**Conclusion:** team efficiency stats add no measurable skill over Elo, and the full feature set
overfits (calibration slope 0.89). The market's edge most likely comes from information neither model
has (injuries, QB changes, news). The feature models stay out of the live runs.

### Player availability (evaluated and built 2026-10-18; not promoted)
- See `docs/data_sources/nflverse_availability.md` (reproduce with `scripts/analysis/`). Downloaded
  nflverse injuries 2009–2026 (2.0 MB) and depth charts 2001–2026 (16.1 MB), owner-approved, CC-BY 4.0.
- Injury `date_modified` exists 2010–2024 and is pregame (median ≈ 47–55 h before kickoff); missing in
  2009 and absent from 2025. Weekly depth charts (≤ 2024) lag but aren't hindsight-filled; 2025+ depth
  charts are daily timestamped snapshots (QB1 = actual starter 91%). Schedule QB ids are hindsight.
- Signal (validation ≤ 2019 only): starting QB changes in ≈ 11% of team-games and moves results ≈ 7.5
  points of win probability against Elo. Upper bound with *hindsight* starter + QB quality: −0.0015
  Brier vs Elo (≈ a quarter of the market gap); the pregame injury-report proxy alone: −0.0003 (n.s.).
- Built `elo_qb` (expected starter from point-in-time injury reports, QB rating from prior
  qb_epa/dropback, ridge logistic on Elo). Validation 2010–2019: **−0.0002 Brier vs Elo, 95% CI
  [−0.0012, +0.0007], no clear difference**; helps on Out/Doubtful games (−0.0041, n = 131) but those
  are rare. Not promoted to live. A scaling bug for rare flags was found and fixed during validation.

### Score-margin and game-total distributions (Stage 2, 2026-10-18)
- `sfi backtest-scores`: walk-forward predictive distributions over integer margins (home − away) and
  totals; archived as quantile summaries (`archive/score_forecasts.jsonl`). Holdout sealed.
- Models: `scores_naive` (past outcomes only), `scores_elo_*` (margin mean from tuned Elo points edge,
  OLS refit each season), `scores_points_*` (team offense/defense scoring ratings; untuned defaults).
  Spread from each model's own past residuals: `*_normal` (discretized Normal) or `*_empirical` (residual
  shape, keeps key-number mass).
- Evaluation: CRPS, MAE (median), RMSE (mean), pinball loss, 50/80/90% central-interval coverage tested
  against each forecast's own claimed mass (95% Wilson interval), randomized-PIT χ² uniformity test,
  market spread/total lines as point benchmarks.

Validation 2001–2019 (5,065 games):

| Target | Best model | CRPS | vs naive | MAE | Market line MAE | Coverage 50/80/90 (obs/claimed) |
|---|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---|
| Margin | scores_points_empirical | 7.63 | −0.61 [−0.68, −0.53] | 10.63 | 10.41 | .528/.523, .816/.812, .905/.908 ✓ |
| Total | scores_points_empirical | 7.70 | −0.22 [−0.28, −0.15] | 10.85 | 10.66 | .535/.526, .812/.812, .908/.909 ✓ |

- Intervals are calibrated for every model (all ✓). Normal spreads fail the PIT shape test (χ² ≈ 26–50:
  key numbers), empirical spreads pass (χ² 4.9–9.0); CRPS is the same either way.
- Points model vs Elo on margin: −0.025 CRPS [−0.053, +0.004], not clearly better.
- Implied P(home win) from the margin distribution: Brier 0.2192, consistent with `elo_tuned` (0.2194).
- The market is still more accurate: model MAE − market MAE = +0.22 [+0.14, +0.30] (margin) and
  +0.20 [+0.13, +0.26] (total).

### Player yardage distributions (2026-10-18; backtest only, not live)
- `sfi backtest-players`: walk-forward passing, rushing and receiving yard distributions per player.
  Player-game totals from play-by-play match official 2019 totals for the yardage leaders exactly.
- **Pregame pool** (the main leakage risk): players with ≥ 10 pass attempts / 3 carries / 2 targets for the
  team in its last 2 released games, still on the team, not listed Out/Doubtful on an injury report known
  by the as-of time; for passing only the expected starter. Pool players who then get no opportunity are
  scored as 0 yards, so evaluation never conditions on who played.
- Models: `players_recent_avg` (mean of last 4 appearances) and `players_opp_eff` (recent volume × shrunk
  career yards per opportunity × opponent allowed-rate adjustment). Spreads from each model's own past
  residuals at a similar mean. All settings untuned. No player-prop market data for comparison.

Validation 2010–2019 (holdout sealed):

| Stat | Forecasts | No-opportunity share | CRPS recent avg | CRPS opp × eff | opp × eff − recent | Coverage 50/80/90 (opp × eff, obs/claimed) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| Passing | 5,283 | 6.8% | 51.78 | 52.03 | +0.25 [−0.13, +0.64] n.s. | .497/.506, .801/.804, .896/.904 ✓ |
| Rushing | 17,701 | 19.6% | 14.32 | 13.87 | −0.46 [−0.53, −0.39] better | .535/.527, .831/.819, .921/.913 (slightly too wide) |
| Receiving | 41,752 | 20.4% | 14.38 | 14.14 | −0.24 [−0.30, −0.19] better | .529/.527, .818/.819, .912/.914 ✓ |

- Receiving is calibrated in coverage and shape (PIT χ² 13 < 16.9). Rushing intervals are about 1 point
  too wide (conservative); PIT flags shape for rushing and passing.
- Development note: the first run forecast every QB with recent attempts; 14% of pool QBs then threw no
  passes, making passing forecasts bimodal (CRPS 56). Restricting to the expected starter cut that to
  6.8% (CRPS 52). Changed on validation results; holdout untouched.
- The player backtest archive (`archive/player_forecasts.jsonl`, git-ignored) is ~400 MB after two model
  versions; re-runs of the same version add nothing.

### Synthetic results (pipeline check only)
Synthetic holdout 2023–2024 (525 games): tuned Elo 0.2454 Brier, Platt 0.2449, default 0.2524, oracle
0.2351. The holdout was viewed once before the K grid was widened (from the validation edge signal only).

### Prospective forecasting (built 2026-10-18)
- **First live run:** 2026-10-18T19:38:24Z, run `90f9f0675c61`, snapshot `sha256:2384f5f3bc7c2eb5`,
  code `f5962f9`; 54 forecasts for 18 games (week 6 late games through week 7); ledger committed
  in `a6456ff`, 26 min before the first kickoff. Week 7 forecasts predate week 6 results, so
  re-run before those games; scoring uses the latest pre-kickoff forecast.
- `sfi forecast`: frozen tuned Elo (K 20, HFA 48, regression 0.5, chosen on 2001–2019), replays all
  history to the current time, and forecasts unplayed games in the next 8 days (at least 10 min before
  kickoff). Models archived: `elo_tuned` (primary), `elo_tuned_platt`, `home_rate`.
- Ledger `ledger/prospective_forecasts.jsonl` plus run log `ledger/forecast_runs.jsonl` (snapshot,
  code commit and dirty flag, tuned-parameter hash, market line at issue time as a benchmark).
- Refuses stale data: snapshot older than 24h, or any game whose result should be known but isn't.
  Verified: refuses the 2026-10-15 snapshot (72h old, SEA@DEN and HOU@JAX results missing).
- `sfi score`: latest pre-kickoff forecast per model and game; excludes forecasts issued after the
  actual kickoff; compares with the market at issue time and the snapshot's (likely closing) line.
- A test confirms a live forecast equals the backtest forecast for the same game and as-of time.
- **Margin/total live (2026-10-18):** each run also archives `scores_points_empirical` (primary) and
  `scores_naive` margin/total distributions with their full pmfs, and records the market spread/total
  at issue time (benchmark). `sfi score` scores them exactly (CRPS, MAE, coverage, PIT) against market
  lines at issue and in the scoring snapshot. A test confirms live = backtest distributions at the same as-of.
- **Player yards live (2026-10-18):** each run also archives `players_opp_eff` passing/rushing/receiving
  distributions (full pmf) with P(yards ≥ x) for pass 200/250/300, rush and rec 50/75/100, for the
  pregame pool (expected QB starter; recent-usage players not listed Out/Doubtful). Report:
  `reports/upcoming_player_forecasts.md`. Player forecasts are skipped if play-by-play lags results by
  more than 48 h; younger gaps are recorded in the run log. `sfi score` scores them exactly (CRPS, MAE,
  coverage) plus Brier for each threshold. `sfi fetch --live` (used by the scheduled runs) refreshes the
  current season's play-by-play and injuries, downloading only when changed; scheduled-task prompts updated.
  Dry run: 375 player forecasts for 17 games in ~23 s. Caveat: QBs who only recently took over get very
  wide passing distributions (their errors are pooled with past backup-QB forecasts).
- **Automated (2026-10-18):** `scripts/live_run.ps1` (fetch → forecast → score → commit `ledger/`),
  run by Claude desktop scheduled tasks `nfl-live-forecast-weekday` (Mon and Thu 3:00 PM ET) and
  `nfl-live-forecast-sunday` (Sun 8:30 AM ET) and `nfl-live-forecast-sunday-evening` (Sun 6:30 PM ET),
  saved in Auto mode. They only run while the app is open.
  Each run forecasts all games in the next 8 days, so every game gets several forecasts and scoring
  uses the latest pre-kickoff one. The Sunday-evening run refreshes Sunday-night games with that
  afternoon's results. Gap: Thanksgiving 12:30 games are last forecast on Monday.

### Not built / not verified
- No live forecast has been scored yet (all 18 games pending).
- No weather-forecast features; no joint (correlated) simulations across players or game outcomes.
- No database, API, dashboard, agents/orchestrator, scheduling, model registry (Stages 3–4).
- Local git repository only (branch `main`); no remote, no CI.

### Open decisions (owner)
- When to reveal the 2020–2025 holdout (only after the next model changes are frozen).
- Report the 09:00 kickoff defect upstream to nflverse/nfldata?
- Run environment (local Windows PC assumed for now), budget.
- Abstention thresholds: to be set from empirical studies, not guessed.

### Next steps
0. Challenger `elo_hfa` (time-varying home edge, `docs/challenger_elo_hfa.md`) runs live next to the
   frozen `elo_tuned`; decision at ≥ 500 scored prospective games (paired Brier CI). No tuning until then.
1. Start live runs: `sfi fetch` then `sfi forecast` before each slate; `sfi score` after results.
2. Player yardage distributions are built and live. Options: improve passing (opponent pass defense,
   QB-specific adjustments, narrower spreads for new starters), or reveal the holdout for an honest
   estimate of the frozen models.
3. Score-margin and total distributions with interval-coverage tests.
4. Optional: remote repository and CI running pytest.
